gateMechanismVerifiedAtSource.note: G-133's close states the credential is 'carried in HAUSKA_TENANT_KEY' -- read at source (P:/smartcity-dashboards src/tenancy.mjs on origin/main@35a4ae2, fetched fresh) to confirm before writing any documentation citing it, since propagating a prior close's paraphrase without re-checking is exactly the failure class G-133's own close named against G-128/G-116.
gateMechanismVerifiedAtSource.finding: No env var named HAUSKA_TENANT_KEY (singular) exists anywhere in the deployed code. The real mechanism: on Cloud Run (K_SERVICE set), resolveHauskaTenant ALWAYS resolves the tenant live -- the caller presents a raw key value in the x-hauska-key request header, this service calls HAUSKA_MCP_URL's own /auth/whoami with that same header, and reads jurisdiction_tenant off the response. HAUSKA_TENANT_KEYS (plural) exists but is a LOCAL/unit-test-only static JSON map (parseTenantKeyMap), explicitly disabled whenever K_SERVICE is set -- it never applies to the deployed surface.
gateMechanismVerifiedAtSource.secondMechanismConsideredAndRejected: Considered: maybe HAUSKA_TENANT_KEY is an alias resolved elsewhere (e.g. a build-time env substitution) rather than genuinely absent. Rejected: grepped the full deployed src/tenancy.mjs and its only two Hauska-key-shaped env references are HAUSKA_TENANT_KEYS (local bypass) and HAUSKA_MCP_URL (the endpoint) -- no substitution layer exists in this repo (plain process.env reads throughout, confirmed by reading envMap's call sites).
gateMechanismVerifiedAtSource.consequenceForDeliverable2: The dispatch's instruction to name 'HAUSKA_TENANT_KEY' in .env.example would document a variable the code does not read. Documenting the REAL mechanism (HAUSKA_MCP_URL + the per-request x-hauska-key header + HAUSKA_TENANT_KEYS as the local-only bypass) serves the dispatch's actual intent -- guidance instead of silence -- more accurately than the literal instruction. Flagged here rather than silently substituted.
